Twenty Years of jQuery: How a Little Library Rewired Web Development
items.blurb: jQuery, created by John Resig and released in 2006, is a JavaScript library that simplifies HTML manipulation, event handling, animation, and Ajax. It enabled easier web development by providing an accessible API across browsers.

items.title: Bumping the Major Version of Your JavaScript Library is User Hostile
how method memoization helped cut
items.blurb: A bare z.string() retained 7.5kb of heap in Zod 4.4. In Zod 4.5 it retains 784 bytes. One change to where a schema's methods live accounts for nearly all of it.
